identity_reason: it is the Select groove for its field, a level-4 Card for its popover and Calendar inside, so its look comes from those
concept: A field in the Select groove that opens Calendar on a level-4 popover; choosing closes it and puts focus back on the field.

trigger.why: the chosen date is set in tabular figures so it does not shift as it changes

placeholder.why: the empty field shows its placeholder in the secondary tone

glyph.why: a calendar glyph at the end says the field opens a calendar

pop.why: the calendar sits on a level-4 popover with the shared popover padding

data-readonly.why: a read-only value drops the groove for a hairline, so it reads as settled but can still be focused and copied

aria-invalid=true.why: a wrong answer takes the critical ring a field takes, and FormField says what is wrong in words

@pop.why: the calendar popover rises a short distance and settles like every popover
